capabilities: Install a Markdown instruction module with agent modes into the vault
Generate a seven-day menu and keep menu history via Copilot Agent Chat
Record purchases, consumption, waste and stock corrections to update inventory
Create recipe and product cards catalogued with Dataview
Assemble a shopping list from missing or low ingredients
disambiguation: Not a recipe database; the package ships empty working notes and card templates, and recipes and product cards are created as you use the assistant.
extras: Module scenarios and instructions are currently in Russian only. The plugin is still awaiting Obsidian community directory review, so beta installs go through BRAT. MVP limits: the plugin cannot programmatically send the prompt (Copilot offers no public API for that), store shopping is an external MCP tool, and consumption forecasts require accumulated history.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in food and meal-planning workflows, and AI chat plugins come without ready-made domain scenarios for recipes, stock and shopping.

relations.evidence: Copilot and Dataview are separate community plugins that must be installed and configured independently.
community plugin Dataview для живых каталогов
Установите community plugin BRAT в тестовый vault.

summary: Module installer that sets up local Markdown-based recipe cards, inventory, weekly menus and shopping lists driven by an AI agent in Copilot Agent Chat.
